5. Recompute every scan no retained state. Initially outputs 0 flags false; apply rules first call. tolerance.

They don't compute diff due IF. Good. But potential DINT subtraction overflow? Since valid values only then 0..20000 difference safe. Fine.
- Selection tie: initializes found false; AB first if ok sets. AC only if diffAC < bestDiff, not <=, so ties keep AB. BC only if diffBC < bestDiff, ties keep previous. This gives AB tie over AC and BC; AC tie over BC if AB absent or diff less? Wait tie order AB, AC, BC. If AB not ok, AC first then BC tie keeps AC. If AB ok and AC tie, AB. If AB diff bigger? Suppose AB ok diff 200, AC diff 100, BC diff 100. AC selected because diffAC < bestDiff 200. BC diff 100 < bestDiff 100 false, keeps AC. Tie AC before BC. Good.
- But issue: bestDiff initialized 0, found false. okay.
- PairMask USINT assigned integer literals.

- Overload computed VotedKg > 10000.0. Fine.
- ReleasePermit only in IF found; else false. Fine.
- No retained state? VAR local not retained, okay.
